card_issue_date.description: The date on which the credit card was issued.

card_expiration_date.description: Card expiry must be in the future

credit_limit.description: The maximum credit available through the credit card.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate of the credit card.

payment_frequency.description: The payment cadence for the credit card.

payment_due_date.description: The date on which the next payment towards the credit card balance is due.

minimum_payment.description: The minimum balance amount that must be paid off in each statement period.

current_balance.description: The current amount of used credit on the credit card. The more negative the number, the more debt has been accrued.

available_credit.description: The remaining amount of credit available to be spent on the card.

last_statement_balance.description: The total amount owed at the time of the last card statement.

total_paid_year_to_date.description: How much the card holder has paid into the credit card account so far in the current calendar year.
